code:
As Of Date = MAX ( 'Date'[Date] )

Active Customers =
VAR AsOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN
CALCULATE (
    DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales_Orders[CustomerID] ),
    Sales_Orders[OrderTotal] > 0,
    DATESBETWEEN ( 'Date'[Date], AsOf - 90, AsOf )
)
caption: A measure, not a hardcoded date — it recalculates on refresh.

code:
Churned Customers =
VAR AsOf = [As Of Date]
RETURN
COUNTROWS ( FILTER (
  VALUES ( Sales_Customers[CustomerID] ),
  VAR LastOrder = CALCULATE ( MAX(Sales_Orders[OrderDate]),
                               Sales_Orders[OrderTotal]>0 )
  VAR DaysSince = DATEDIFF ( LastOrder, AsOf, DAY )
  VAR Prior12mo = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS(Sales_Orders),
                    Sales_Orders[OrderTotal]>0,
                    DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date],AsOf-365,AsOf) )
  RETURN NOT ISBLANK(LastOrder) && DaysSince>90 && Prior12mo>=2
) )
caption: DAX has no CASE-over-CTE — this rebuilds it as per-customer row logic.

code:
Churn Rate =
VAR EligibleBase = [Active Customers] + [Churned Customers]
RETURN DIVIDE ( [Churned Customers], EligibleBase )
caption: The denominator excludes never-purchased and not-yet-retained customers.
